english: Wolf refugees.

chinese: 东边的高原是圣地，西边的行省则赐给了忍者。

english: The monks and ninja were always fighting, and my father sought to separate them.
chinese: 僧侣和忍者向来争斗，父亲想把他们隔开。

status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: True...and if we enlist the ninja, we can be certain the monks will join the Lotus.

chinese: 为什么举白旗求和？

english: The Orb is meaningless.
chinese: 宝珠已无意义。

status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

chinese: 我知道：他若不杀你，我也会杀你。

english: For years, his descendants cowered behind their stone walls, hating each other and fearing the dark.
chinese: 多年来，他的后代躲在石壁后，互相憎恨，又惧怕黑暗。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: They never understood that even in the very heart of Serpentholm, shadows lurked in every corner.
chinese: 他们不明白，即使在 Serpentholm 的中心，阴影也潜伏在每个角落。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: The darkness will always be out there, trying to make us afraid.
chinese: 黑暗永远都在外面，想让我们感到恐惧。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: But we'll hide no longer.
chinese: 但我们不会再躲藏。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: We face the future a united land.
chinese: 这片土地将团结一心，迎接未来。
status: draft; later Kenji arc; not game-tested

english: It's time to make the shadows afraid.
chinese: 该让阴影害怕我们了。

english: No.

status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: True...the peasants are an ill-mannered bunch, in need of schooling.
chinese: 没错……农民这群人没规矩，得好好教训。

english: Submit or I'll take your head.

chinese: 你知道我是谁。

chinese: 你们以前都是灵蛇族的人。

chinese: 现在你们要么归我，要么都得死。

chinese: 它在哪里？

english: You gave the sacred orb to the geisha?
chinese: 你们把神圣的宝珠交给了艺妓？

english: Curse that wretched old man!
chinese: 该死的老东西！
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: The Serpent was a fool.
chinese: 巨蛇太糊涂了。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

chinese: 莲花族一直眼红宝珠的力量。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: The old taboos won't last much longer.

chinese: 我们必须快点行动。

chinese: 最近的路直穿 Riverside。

chinese: 真是好极了。

chinese: 就像从前……
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

chinese: 当初就该趁机把他们全杀了。

english: My brother was right.
chinese: 我哥哥说得对。

chinese: 我的家园。他们的田地、牲口、女儿和儿子——全都属于我。

english: This is Serpent land.
chinese: 这是灵蛇族的土地。

chinese: 总还有比我更坏的人。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

chinese: 让部队出发。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

chinese: 继续赶路，黄昏前就能到天鹅池。

english: Give me Tarrant's Orb.
chinese: 把 Tarrant 的宝珠交给我。

english: It will be safer in my hands.
chinese: 放在我手里更安全。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: Are you mad?
chinese: 你疯了吗？
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: So you saw him too.
chinese: 这么说你也看见他了。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: Don't they understand who I am?
chinese: 他们难道不明白我是谁？

english: No.
chinese: 不。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: We hit them, hard and fast.
chinese: 打过去，快而狠。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

chinese: 处决话最多的那个，把其他人带来。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

chinese: 快。
status: draft; Kenji Serpent branch; not game-tested

english: Good.

chinese: 或许我们该撤退。

chinese: 你疯了！
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

chinese: 只能在较平的地面上建造，所以要好好规划。

chinese: 很好！

chinese: 记住，左键用于取消或选中，右键用于执行动作。

chinese: 看！我们建的农舍里走出了一名新农民。

status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

chinese: 让我们从那边的稻田收些稻米。

english: Rice is the currency of this land and is used in all construction and training efforts.
chinese: 稻米在这里可作交换，也用于一切建造和训练。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

chinese: 左键选中一名农民，把画面移到稻田，再右键点击稻田。

status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: Look at the forest...how strange.

status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

english: You've grown up.
chinese: 你长大了。

chinese: 他残害你父亲的人民。
status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

status: draft; later Otomo arc; not game-tested

chinese: 你父亲死后，氏族就分崩离析了。

chinese: 他知道 Serpentholm 会陷落。

chinese: 艺妓仍被视为不可侵犯。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 你父亲死了七年，他的威势已衰，但恶狼族和莲花族仍怕他的名字。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 我怎样服侍父亲，就怎样服侍儿子。

status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 恶狼族已经来到这里，赶走了原本的农民。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 天气好时，他们破屋的臭味会传到南边。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

english: As in your father's time, the Wolf barbarians are woefully unprepared to face a battle-ready foe.
chinese: 和你父亲在世时一样，恶狼族根本挡不住有备而来的军队。

chinese: 不过，恶狼族总想找人打一架。

chinese: 莲花族的领地远在东边，却在这里建了前哨。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 他们一名邪恶术士用黑暗法术奴役了当地农民。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 村民熟悉土地，会是有用的盟友。

chinese: 最近的路穿过 Riverside Town 中心。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 本地人靠与莲花族、恶狼族交易过活，我们肯定会被发现。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 哈！大家又并肩作战，真像从前，不是吗？

chinese: 探子报告，商人也从 Riverside 逃走，不敢面对你。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 我已经自作主张，派人占了镇子。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 探子报告，莲花族也弃掉前哨，不敢面对你。
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 西边的恶狼族占地者还没走，但一点刀剑与火焰就能让他们……
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 东边的莲花族术士还没动，但若烧了他们的塔……
status: draft; Shinja campaign arc; not game-tested

chinese: 可我们已拿住他们的要害。
